summary: The change sets a default permission for file uploads, which could help resolve the mentioned issue.

issues.description: The change does not address the underlying issue of inconsistent file permissions between MemoryUploadedFile and TemporaryUploadedFile. It only sets a default permission, which may not fully resolve the problem.
The change introduces a new default value for FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS, which is consistent with the style of the surrounding code, but it could be documented better.
